messages:
katie_sales: FYI — Meridian wants to kick off a paid POC but listed a few hard blockers: must have signed orderform before any billing, DPA has permissive subprocessor language, customer-managed keys (HSM) requested, and EU unit insists on physical signature for final MSA. tagging @mike_legal @sophia_procure @ian_se @nora_security.

mike_legal: Paste their DPA clause? if it allows transfers w/o notice we push back. Our usual fixes: notice + 30-day objection window or named-subprocessor appendix. I'll draft both.

katie_sales: Their clause: "Vendor may engage legacy subprocessors and transfer Customer Data internationally without prior notification."

mike_legal: Can't accept. I'll draft (A) notify + 30-day objection + SCCs, and (B) appendix with named subprocessors and consent for additions. Will post by COB.

sophia_procure: On the signed-orderform requirement: we can hold activation until PO is received or accept pre-paid POC credits. Finance default Net30; Net45 needs approval. Recommend an overage cap on orderform (e.g., $1,500) to avoid disputes.

ian_se: Tech note: Hosted doesn't support customer HSM. Dedicated/Private do. If HSM required, POC must move to Dedicated which adds provisioning (~5-10 business days) and cost uplift (~20-30%). Workaround: client-side encryption or scoped managed KMS but procurement may reject.

nora_security: Ask customer to complete our security questionnaire and provide SOC2. Also request the EU team's policy text mandating wet-ink — many accept eSign with audit trail. Link: https://redwood.example.com/sec-qa.

acct_billing: If they want no billing without signed orderform we need PO before activation. Pre-bill option: invoice upfront for credits (Net0). If eSign now and later wet-ink required for MSA, tag revenue as "POC - eSign limited" to avoid production recognition.

esign-bot: Envelope ENV-7712 created for Meridian POC orderform. Signers: Meridian PO, katie_sales. Status: pending (expires in 14 days).

katie_sales: Action items: Mike drop redlines here; Ian confirm exact lead-time and cost delta for Dedicated; Sophia/Acct confirm Net terms and overage cap; I'll ask Meridian for the wet-ink policy excerpt and billing contact. Will update once they respond. :thumbsup:
